title: Deeply · adv.

words.note: 使用者提供。profoundly 是 deeply 最核心、最正式的近義詞之一，常表示某事在思想、情感、人生或社會層面產生很深遠的影響。它比一般 strongly 更強調深度與持久性。
words.example: The experience profoundly changed her view of education.

falseSynonyms.zh: profoundly 強調深刻、深遠、根本性影響；不是所有程度很高的 deeply 都能換成 profoundly。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The discovery profoundly changed the field. I strongly recommend the book.

falseSynonyms.zh: strongly 常表立場、信念、支持／反對力度；deeply 可以是深刻影響或物理深度。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I strongly oppose the proposal. The roots grow deeply into the soil.

falseSynonyms.zh: intensely 強調感官、活動、情緒或注意力的高強度；不一定有長期深遠意味。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They competed intensely. The event profoundly changed him.

falseSynonyms.zh: greatly 是較一般的程度副詞，常配 improve/benefit/increase；deeply 更常有情緒／深度色彩。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The change greatly reduced costs. She was deeply moved.

falseSynonyms.zh: keenly 常與 aware/conscious/felt 搭配，突出敏銳意識；不是所有 deep feeling 都可用 keenly。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She was keenly aware of the risk. She was deeply grateful.

falseSynonyms.zh: sincerely 表達真誠；deeply 表達程度。兩者在 regret/apologise 等語境可重疊，但焦點不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON I sincerely apologise. I deeply regret the loss.

falseSynonyms.zh: seriously 表示事情嚴重或態度認真；deeply 可表示情感深度，兩者不能機械互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We are seriously concerned. She was deeply moved.

falseSynonyms.zh: deeply 是副詞；deep 通常是形容詞，也可在部分固定副詞用法中出現，但不能一般替代 deeply。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She was deeply affected. The hole is deep.
